values.note: Online reservations only (Brown County WebTrac), same day up to 364 days ahead; non-refundable. Holiday minimum on Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day. Then 14 days away before another 21-day stay. Check-in 3:15 pm, check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.browncountywi.gov/community/parks-department/general-information/camping/ ('This campground requires online reservations only. Reservations may be made day-of and up to 364 days in advance.'; 'Reservations made Friday – Saturday (weekend) require 2 or more nights'; 'Camping is allowed for no more than 21 consecutive days.')

note: Brown County Parks campground in the woods of the 1,400-acre Reforestation Camp (E.J. Smith), opened 2022; gravel pads. The gravel entrance road leaves the southeast corner of the zoo's upper parking lot, with a 14-ft height clearance (not a length limit). Five sites allow horses, and bike and horse trails leave from the campground; the NEW Zoo & Adventure Park is under a half-mile walk. --Claude
summary: County page confirms $34 W/E / $44 full-hookup 50-amp (rustic $22), 51 sites (47 drive-in), online-only WebTrac booking 364 days ahead with weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums, 21-night max, close Nov 1 2026 (opening not posted). Not waterfront kept (two small ponds). Pin ~720 m off at the zoo entrance: moves to the loops. Five horse-allowed sites flagged.
